## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (66%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Degraded frozen section failed quality checks [F6], leaving all four classes possible [F1] and margins deferred [F7].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|InSitu 66%, Normal 13%, Benign 11%, Invasive 10% (ECE 5%)|Leans InSitu; 10% invasive risk|
|Conformal set|Normal, Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% target, 90% coverage)|Cannot exclude any class|
|Reliability / OOD|12% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD (70% AUROC)|Suspect input; out of distribution|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement|Disagree (false)|Foundation models disagree|
|Similar cases|0/5 (0%) InSitu; 5/5 Normal (74%–78%) [F5]|All neighbors are Normal|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.225, contribution -0.725) opposes invasion [F2] (19/20 AI check) · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.164, contribution -0.295) [F3]; failed AI check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Typical (0.254, contribution +0.290) [F4]; 8/20 AI check · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low (0.106, contribution +0.272), caption-inconsistent (18/20 AI check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation (severity 3) caused false atypia; all 5 neighbors are Normal and CONCH–MUSK disagree.
- Deeper levels or recut H&E reveal occult invasion or benign tissue missed on this degraded frozen section.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 3**: Highest heatmap risk (16%, 1%); inspect for occult stromal invasion versus resampling artifact.
2. **Regions 8, 7, 11**: Check tubule formation and duct-confined atypia against benign stroma lacking infiltration.
3. **Regions 9, 0**: Verify pleomorphism, TILs, and unreliable mitoses/lobules; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
